title: Text can sound right and be wrong
summary: A model can produce a believable statement that is false. This is often called a hallucination. Smooth writing is not evidence that a fact is correct.
introduction: A model can produce a believable statement that is false. This is often called a hallucination. Smooth writing is not evidence that a fact is correct. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.text: Do not invent a citation or opening time to make an answer feel complete.
